title: Edmund and the Inheritance
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Ivo Galloway, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
